named_blockers.statement: A two-phase raw greedy-decode comparison against pinned llama.cpp acd79d603 matched the first generated token for 'The capital of France is' but diverged at generated index 3 at depth 5 (reference ' Paris. Paris is the', Camelid ' Paris. What is the'). This is not attributed as a near-tie and blocks any CUDA or supported-row claim.

The same 8-prompt x 1/5/50 CPU comparison was stopped after prolonged active non-resident computation without an atomic report. It is neither a pass nor a failure and cannot substitute for a CPU parity certificate.

Phi-4-mini differs materially from the held Phi-3 row (200k vocabulary, partial rotary, fused QKV/FFN geometry). The short raw divergence has not been isolated between forward-path geometry, quantized execution, or other engine causes.

exit_condition: Reproduce and isolate the first non-matching generated token with an exact artifact forward-path investigation, then rerun a complete two-phase parity matrix with current-source tokenizer prompt parity, determinism control, API/WebUI evidence, and bounded CPU/CUDA context evidence before any catalog or supported-row promotion.
